title: PowerPoint: edit presentations with Copilot in the DoD cloud
summary: The briefing accurately reports the disagreement between the roadmap's launched status and the service description's DoD availability, and its licence-assignment path and command are documented. The sentence about one prompt changing multiple slides needs a supporting PowerPoint article cited and should describe template styling rather than changing templates.

claims.claim: Copilot licences can be assigned through Microsoft 365 admin center > Billing > Licenses > product > Assign licenses.
claims.quote: In the admin center, go to the Billing > Licenses page. ... Select a product. ... On the product details page, select Assign licenses.

claims.claim: Set-MgUserLicense -UserId <user> -AddLicenses @{SkuId = "<SkuId>"} -RemoveLicenses @() assigns a product licence to a user.
claims.quote: To assign a license to a user, use the following command in PowerShell. Set-MgUserLicense -UserId $userUPN -AddLicenses @{SkuId = "<SkuId>"} -RemoveLicenses @()

claims.claim: Group-based licence recipients can be identified by inspecting members under Teams & groups > Active teams & groups.
claims.quote: To see which users are receiving the license through that group, go to the Teams & groups > Active teams & groups page to view its members.

claims.claim: Licences can be removed through Billing > Licenses > product > selected users or groups > Unassign licenses.
claims.quote: In the admin center, go to the Billing > Licenses page. ... Select a product. ... Select the check boxes of the users or groups for whom you want to unassign licenses. ... Select Unassign licenses.

claims.claim: Set-MgUserLicense can also remove licences.
claims.quote:
# Unassign E3
Set-MgUserLicense -UserId "belindan@litwareinc.com" -AddLicenses @{} -RemoveLicenses @($e3Sku.SkuId)
